topic: The mathematician regarded as a father of theoretical computer science
core_question: Which British mathematician devised the theoretical 'Turing machine' and is regarded as a father of computer science? (secondary: Who composed the ballet score The Rite of Spring, whose 1913 premiere caused a riot?)
answer_summary: Accept 'Alan Turing' — devised the Turing machine concept and is widely regarded as a father of computer science and artificial intelligence.; after the topic shift: Igor Stravinsky, the Russian composer who wrote The Rite of Spring (1913).
